title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's verified Israel Sports Pulse stories, from a Moscow chess final to a red card in Montreal.

questions.question: In the Toto Cup on August 3, 2026, who scored M.S. Ashdod's second goal in a 2-0 win over Maccabi Jaffa?
questions.explanation: Maor Kuba scored in the third minute of second-half stoppage time, assisted by Khalaileh, who had opened the scoring from the penalty spot.

questions.question: Point guard Tamir Blatt signed a three-year contract for a second stint at which club, even though it reportedly plans to loan him out again?
questions.explanation: Hapoel Tel Aviv signed Blatt through the 2028/29 season, marking his return to the club where he began his career, with ONE reporting a loan is planned almost immediately.

questions.question: In which sport did Oren Smadja win Israel's first Olympic medal by a man, bronze at Barcelona 1992?
questions.explanation: Smadja won Olympic bronze in judo at Barcelona 1992 and later coached Israel's national judo team for about fifteen years.

questions.question: Which MLS club issued a 'zero tolerance' statement after Israeli forward Dor Turgeman was targeted with antisemitic chants at CF Montréal?
questions.explanation: New England Revolution released a formal statement on August 3, 2026 declaring zero tolerance for antisemitism and confirmed it reported the incident to MLS.

questions.question: Boris Gelfand, who settled in Rishon LeZion after emigrating from Minsk, lost the 2012 World Chess Championship in a Moscow rapid tiebreak to whom?
questions.explanation: Viswanathan Anand won the rapid tiebreak 2½–1½ on 30 May 2012 to take the match 8½–7½, denying Gelfand what would have been Israel's first world chess title.
